headline: Peru’s Sol Slips to Six-Month Low Before Central Bank Policy Decision
summary: Peru's sol weakened against the US dollar to S/3.4824 before trimming losses, ahead of the central bank's upcoming interest rate decision on December 10.
why: Emerging market currency fluctuations reflect shifting foreign exchange liquidity and central bank monetary policy expectations.

entities.name: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú

impacts.name: USDPEN
impacts.why: The exchange rate reflects the weakening of the Peruvian sol against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Corporate demand for US dollars at month-end combined with external factors pushed the sol down before a partial recovery supported by metal prices and corporate supply.
